assessments.reasoning: Paragraph 7/3 binds the hook to the dynamic tag of a tagged full type, and 9/3 places component finalization after the applicable whole-object actions.

challenge.method: Compare elementary, tagged controlled and protected cases in §7.6.1(5–9/3), then check §7.6.1(9.1/2) and the independent omission conditions of §7.6.
challenge.results: The source says full type rather than an arbitrary visible view. The component-level rule retains explicit access-discriminant order exceptions, and coextensions follow their designating object. Abstract finalization ordering yields no unconditional count of emitted calls.

limitations: The claim specifies the relative position of the whole-object actions. It leaves the internal component-finalization ordering to paragraph 9/3 and the coextension rule to paragraph 9.1/2.
Exact unannotated Ada 2022 manual edition only. Runtime implementations and other editions require separate evidence.
